mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate above 4.5% (as observed in the snapshot) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to restrictive monetary policy compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production above 110 (index 2017=100) and unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110 and UNRATE < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a 3-month increase in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index exceeding 0.5% signals rising inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 110 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls < 110 in 1 month over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in employment above 136,000 thousand and retail sales above $369,000 million signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 136000 and RSAFS > 369000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25% signals aggressive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 3 months over any 1-year rolling window.
